title: Sign disagreement indicator
statement: Let $f$ map the discrete cube $\{-1,1\}^n$ to $\{-1,1\}$, and let $x,y\in\{-1,1\}^n$. The indicator that $f(x)$ and $f(y)$ differ equals $\bigl(1-f(x)f(y)\bigr)/2$, viewing the signs as real numbers.
